proves.claim: A reject of a submitted sprint item the lander merged writes one pull_out naming its commits and builder, and its landing reads pulling.

store.io-board-sprint-pull-out.landed-sp.why: Without this test a reject of landed sprint work can write no pull_out, and nothing reverts the work on main.

proves.claim: A sprint reject before landing and a steady reject write no pull_out and leave no landing pulling.

store.io-board-sprint-pull-out.unlanded-.why: Sprint wiring must change nothing for steady items or for work that has not landed.
